items.headline: Dakshin Africa: ANC ki sabse badi haar
items.detail: Sthaniya chunav me ANC ko sirf 31% vote mile — 1994 ke baad sabse kharab nateeja; DA 25% ke saath doosre sthan par; mahasachiv Mbalula ne ise 'catastrophic' kaha; ab gathbandhan ki baatchit hogi.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Africa me loktantra aur gathbandhan rajneeti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Novaya Gazeta band, Moscow karyalaya khaali
items.detail: Russia ke swatantra akhbaar Novaya Gazeta ne aaj antim sampadakiya baithak ke baad apna Moscow karyalaya khaali kar diya — 'foreign agent' ka darja aur daan par rok ke baad kaam jaari rakhna namumkin hua; sansthapak Muratov ne abhivyakti ki swatantrata ki appeal ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia me media swatantrata aur press par dabav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Odesa: Godaam par hamla, 3 ki maut
items.detail: Odesa me Russia ke drone hamle me kindergarten aur school ke khane ka godam jal gaya — 2 mahila aur 1 purush ki maut, 1 mahila gambhir ghayal; hamla Abu Dhabi vaarta se ek din pehle hua.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur nagrik nishane — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz: Tanker me aag, chaalak dal surakshit
items.detail: Khasab ke paas ek tanker me aag lagi aur chaalak dal ko nikala gaya, ek ghante baad doosre tanker par hamla hua; Iran ka daava hai ki do tanker mine se takraaye, America ne ek jahaaz ko nishkriya kar diya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg se duniya ke tel ka lagbhag paanchva hissa guzarta hai; UKMTO aur samudri suraksha UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: 2026 chaar sabse garm saalon me
items.detail: WMO ki report ke mutabik January-September 2026 me vaishvik tapman audyogik-kal se pehle ke star se 1.47°C upar raha — 2026 chaar sabse garm saalon me se ek hoga; El Niño ke majboot hone se garmi aur charam mausam 2027 tak jaari rahega.
items.exam_angle: Jalvayu parivartan, El Niño aur COP31 — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine par 317 drone hamle
items.detail: Russia ne raat bhar Ukraine par 317 drone chhode, jinme 105 jet-powered the — vayu raksha ne zyadatar ko roka, phir bhi 31 jagah hamle hue; 28 log ghayal aur Dnipropetrovsk me 6 lakh se zyada logon ki bijli gayi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur urja par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran: Do din me vaarta ka prastaav
items.detail: Iran ne kaha — do din me America se shanti vaarta phir shuru ho sakti hai; shart hai pratibandh aur nausena naakabandi hate aur har morche par yuddh ruke; America ke videsh mantri Rubio ne in sharton ko kharij kar diya tha.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta aur pratibandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Antalya me jalvayu sammelan shuru
items.detail: Sanyukt Rashtra ka COP31 aaj Turkey ke Antalya me shuru hua — lagbhag 200 desh 20 November tak utsarjan, anukoolan aur jalvayu vitt par vaarta karenge; Turkey ki adhyakshata me bijli ki hissedari 2035 tak 35% karne ka lakshya hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31 aur jalvayu vaarta — paryavaran aur antarrashtriya sangathan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine: EU se turant madad ka mechanism
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne von der Leyen se baat ke baad kaha — EU ne Ukraine ke liye vishesh aapatkalin sahayata mechanism sakriya kiya; Russia ke hamlo se bijli, paani aur heating sankat me Kyiv, Dnipro, Sumy, Donetsk aur Kherson ko turant vitt milega; Abu Dhabi vaarta se pehle sthiti par bhi sahmati bani.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur EU ki sahayata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Crete: Naav me 13 pravasiyon ki maut
items.detail: Greece ke tatrakshak ne Crete ke dakshin me ek pravasi naav se 12 shav baramad kiye aur 18 logon ko bachaya; aspatal le jaye gaye 4 me se ek ki baad me maut ho gayi, kul 13 ki maut; maut ka karan abhi agyaat hai; usi raat do aur naavon se 87 pravasi bachaye gaye. (Corrected: pehle 12 maut batayi gayi thi; aspatal me ek aur ki maut ke baad kul sankhya 13 hui.)
items.exam_angle: Bhoomadhya sagar me pravasi sankat aur EU seema niti — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kraków: Hamlaavar ki maut, ghar me 3 shav
items.detail: Kraków me 6 logon ki hatya karne wala 24 saal ka hamlaavar aspatal me mar gaya — police se muthbhed me ghayal hua tha; uske ghar se mata-pita aur behen ke shav mile; jaanch aatankwadi hamle ke roop me jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Europe me suraksha aur aatankwadi jaanch — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Australia: Gmail par umar jaanch ka khatra
items.detail: Google ne Australia ki Senate sunwai me chetavani di — Digital Duty of Care bill ki umar-jaanch shart 18 se kam umar walo ke liye Gmail, messaging aur file storage band karwa sakti hai; bill pratinidhi sabha se pass ho chuka hai, Senate me atka hai; Meta, TikTok aur Snap ne bhi aisi hi chinta jatai.
items.exam_angle: Digital niyaman aur online suraksha kanoon — shasan aur takneek ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kraków: Goli baari me 6 ki maut, shok
items.detail: Poland ke Kraków ke aitihasik Main Market Square me shanivaar ko 24 saal ke hamlaavar ne goliyan chalayi — 6 ki maut, 15 ghayal; hamlaavar Somvaar subah aspatal me mar gaya; uske ghar se uske mata-pita aur behen ke shav bhi mile; Poland me 8-9 November ko rashtriya shok, aatankwaad jaanch shuru.
items.exam_angle: Poland me durlabh saamoohik goli baari aur aatankwaad jaanch — antarrashtriya sambandh aur suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kirishi refinery par drone hamla, aag
items.detail: Ukraine ke drone hamle me Russia ki doosri sabse badi refinery Kirishi me aag lag gayi — Leningrad ke governor ne hamle ki pushti ki; hawai raksha ne 113 drone giraye; girte malbe se ek mahila ki maut.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur urja buniyadi dhanche par hamle — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Taiyuan: Imarat me aag, 14 ki maut
items.detail: China ke Taiyuan shahar me ek unchi imarat me aag lagne se kam se kam 14 logon ki maut, 38 ko aspatal bheja gaya; aag lagbhag do ghante me bujhai gayi, kaaran ki jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Gaza: Baarish se 70,000 tent doobe
items.detail: Gaza me shanivaar se bhaari baarish se lagbhag 70,000 tent doob gaye — hazaaron visthapit beghar; Deir al-Balah ke paas ret ka teela girne se 3 bachchon samet 5 ki maut; UNICEF ke mutaabik 1 lakh se zyada logon ko vaikalpik aashray chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Gaza me manaviya sankat aur sardiyon me aashray ki kami — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Deportation neeti 'too tough' rahi
items.detail: CBS ke 60 Minutes interview me Trump ne mana — nirvasan neeti 'too tough' rahi; naukri aur parivar wale pravasiyon ko hatane se midterm me party ko nuksan hua; phir bhi neeti badalne ki ghoshna nahi ki, ICE ka lagbhag 19,000 giraftari prati hafta ka lakshya barkarar hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki pravasi neeti aur midterm chunav — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hasina: Passport maanga, wapsi ka sanket
items.detail: Bangladesh ki apadasth PM Sheikh Hasina ne Delhi sthit dutavas se naya passport aur pehchan patra maanga — December me wapsi aur adalat ke saamne surrender ki yojna; Dhaka ne kaha pratyarpan sandhi se hi wapsi hogi. (Updated: Dhaka ne passport dene se saaf inkaar kar diya — pratyarpan hi ekmatra rasta hai.)
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti aur Bharat-Bangladesh sambandh — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China: America par 24% tariff sthagan badha
items.detail: China ne America se aayat par 24% atirikt shulk ka sthagan do mahine aur badha diya — 10 November se lagu, 10% shulk barkarar; dono deshon ke beech $60 arab ke paraspar shulk katauti package par baat jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: America-China vyapaar yuddh viram aur shulk neeti — arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: Shutdown khatm hone ki ore
items.detail: Senate ne Ravivar raat 60-40 se sarkar kholne ki deal aage badhayi — 40 din se band sarkar, itihas ki sabse lambi; 8 Democrats ne saath diya; House me Budhvar ko vote ki ummeed, phir Trump ke hastakshar.
items.exam_angle: America ki sarkar band hone ka record aur Senate ki prakriya — antarrashtriya rajneeti ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paris: G7 mantriyon ki Ukraine-Iran baithak
items.detail: Paris me G7 videsh mantriyon ki do din ki baithak shuru — Ukraine me nishpaksh shanti aur Iran par naye hamle rokne par charcha; America ke videsh mantri Marco Rubio dono din shamil honge; Abu Dhabi me Russia-Ukraine vaarta se pehle Europe ki chinta par bhi baat hogi.
items.exam_angle: G7, Ukraine yuddh aur Iran tanaav — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nvidia: CEO par jasusi jaanch
items.detail: Nvidia ke board ne CEO Jensen Huang par videshi jasusi ke nishane par hone ke aaropon par swatantra jaanch shuru ki — board ke mutabik ab tak rashtriya suraksha ya company ke rahasya se samjhaute ka koi saboot nahi mila; Huang jaanch me sahyog karenge.
items.exam_angle: America-China chip yuddh aur takneek suraksha — antarrashtriya sambandh aur arthvyavastha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump aaj Qatar ke PM se milenge
items.detail: Trump aaj White House me Qatar ke PM Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani se milenge — Qatar Iran se vaarta me naye prastaav laa raha hai; Rubio ne kaha vaarta me khaas pragati nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran parmanu vaarta me Qatar ki madhyasthata — antarrashtriya sambandh ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Paraguay: Bank dooba, Rashtrapati hataaye gaye
items.detail: Ueno Bank ke doobne se lakhon ki bachat phans gayi; Rashtrapati Santiago Peña ne 5 November ko istifa diya, Senate ne 6 November ko unhe hata diya; 7 November ko dhokhadhadi ke aarop me hiraasat me liye gaye; up-Rashtrapati Pedro Alliana naye Rashtrapati bane.
items.exam_angle: Banking niyaman ki nakami se rashtrapati ka patan — vittiya sankat aur loktantra ke liye case study.
